title: Add smoke wrapper drift map and duplicate test-name report
summary: Add deterministic tooling and generated artifacts that map smoke wrappers to their underlying tests and report exact duplicate Python test names for future consolidation review.
reason: The test coverage rationalization pass recommended machine-readable smoke wrapper drift checks and a focused duplicate-test-name report so wrapper/docs/release drift and exact-name overlap stay visible without manual scripts.
behavior_before: Smoke wrapper ownership and exact duplicate test names were documented by audit text or ad hoc AST scripts, and release layout checks could drift from smoke docs without a generated source-tree guard.
behavior_after: Generated tooling records smoke wrapper to module ownership, docs/release presence, and exact duplicate Python test names. Release/tooling guards can fail on stale generated artifacts or smoke wrapper reference drift.
manual_validation: 2026-06-18: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.tooling.test_smoke_wrapper_map tests.python.tooling.test_duplicate_test_name_report tests.python.tooling.test_active_doc_references tests.python.tooling.test_summary_integrity tests.python.tooling.test_change_control -q passed (55 tests).

2026-06-18: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.generate_smoke_wrapper_map --check passed; map is current with 30 wrappers and zero drift findings.
rollback_plan: Remove the two new dev-tool modules and their tests, remove generated SMOKE_WRAPPER_MAP.json and DUPLICATE_TEST_NAMES.md, remove the release guard entries and smoke-doc pointers, restore docs to their prior wording, and delete this change packet if the packet is abandoned.
notes: Low-risk tooling and documentation only. No runtime APIs, schemas, media policy, WebView behavior, smoke wrapper behavior, PowerShell behavior, test assertions, launchers, source/scratch/output file movement, pending-publish behavior, or Tauri lifecycle behavior are intentionally changed. The generated smoke map reflects 30 current worktree wrappers, including the pre-existing untracked Local API repair/reconcile dry-run wrapper.
